evidence: Te Whara Track follows an ancient Māori trail from Ocean Beach to Urquharts Bay.
Te Whara Track starts at Ocean Beach car park on Ranui Road.
The track ends at the Urquharts Bay car park.
The track is not a loop, so you will need to arrange transport.

doubts: There is no road-end feature for the Ocean Beach car park on Ranui Road; the start is given the place Ocean Beach (T10), the locality the car park is named for, rather than the beach itself (T9). The Peach Cove Track access point is given the walk link (L2), but the text refers to its entrance, which has no feature.
